rows.text:
Hey there, greedy goblin. I'm {nib}. I was just in the middle of enjoying my nap when you had to barge into this dungeon and start swiping loot left n' right!
(Click 'next' to continue)
Well, now you've gone and done it â€” the monsters are coming to claim their stuff, and you're going to have to defend yourself with that loot or else die in this strange catacomb.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Highlights dungeon wheel)
Welcome to the Merry Go' Round of doom â€” a series of circular catacombs that rotate around this particular spot. Don't ask me why, the architect of this dungeon doesn't like answering questions.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Highlights single empty slice of dungeon wheel)
This is a Corridor â€” there are 8 in total. Monsters will pop into these slots as they line up to clean your clock and take your junk.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Highlights player hotbar)
This is your loot. Looks like you started off with some basic loot for this tutorial, but you'll find lots of fancy weapons and armor out here.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(Sprite of {nib} comes very close to the player, nearly covering 80% of the screen)
Your mission...
(Click to continue)
(Comes closer)
...is to get out of the dungeon with as much loot as possible.
(Returns to his original position)
...Got it?
(Click 'Got It' to continue)
Okay, let me show you how things work a'ROUND these parts.
(Click 'next' to continue)
(in very tiny text, in italics parentheses) â€” (y'know, cause of the round dungeon...)
(Click to continue)
(Highlight the healthbar)
You have 6 health (HP). You can never have more than 6. If it reaches 0 at any point, you're dead.
(Click to continue)
When you complete a Dungeon (clear out this wheel), you will heal back to full HP. Spend your HP wisely.
(Click to continue)
Alright, that's enough. Let's learn the rest as we go. Click the Wizard on the wheel.
(Click the Wizard)
Ahh, a crotchety ol' wizard, eh?
(Click to continue)
(Highlights Wizard's Attack icon)
He looks pretty scary â€” 5 Attack would nearly kill you in one strike.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights Wizard's HP icon)
...but he's also super frail. Most weapons will kill him before he gets to strike.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights the Sai)
Use the Sai. It will kill him and end the fight.
(Click the Sai to use it, resolving combat as normal)
1 down, nice. When an Enemy is Defeated, it will trigger the Dungeon to Spin again.
(Click to continue)
(Only NOW does the wheel Spin, and will now land on Golem)
Interesting...this Golem is much harder to kill, so you'd usually want to block this.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights Block icon on the character)
Block is temporary for the current fight. It goes away whenever you Spin the Dungeon.
(Click to continue)
But I've got good news â€” if you Block an enemy, they are also Defeated.
(Click to continue)
({nib} gets 50% closer to the viewer, 'leaning' in)
I guess they just...run out of time to kill you, I guess? Not sure, this Dungeon is kinda weird.
(Click to continue)
({nib} returns to his position)
(Highlights the Helmet item in the hotbar)
Anyway, look at the Helmet, since this item has a unique ability.
(Click to continue)
Hover any item to see its details at a glance.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights the detail view panel to the right)
Looks like the Helmet's Block is based on whichever HP is lower between you and your Enemy.
(Click to continue)
(Highlight both player HP and the Golem's HP)
In this case, that's you with 6 HP.
(Click to continue)
Glad you didn't lose 5 HP to the Wizard earlier, that would make this Helmet useless!
(Click to continue)
Items change all the time based on circumstances. Your job is to juggle your loot to maximize their effectiveness against the unique enemies in the dungeon.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights the Helmet again)
Okay, let's use the Helmet and Block this incoming attack.
(Click the Helmet)
(Highlights the 'Safe' button)
This button will always show you how much HP you are going to lose if you end the fight now.
(Click to continue)
Since you are safe, you can click 'Safe' to end the fight.
(Click 'Safe' and resolve the combat)
Great, so you've Defeated enemies in 2 different ways, by Attacking and Defending.
(Click to continue)
There's one final type of item. Click the Goblin on the wheel.
(Click the Goblin)
Aww, look at this little guy! He is so cute...but he also has an ability.
(Click to continue)
(Highlight on the Monster card)
Hover any monster to learn their ability, just like items.
(When the user hovers)
Aw, Goblins are 'Evasive', so they cannot take Attack damage! Looks like our Knucklers would be wasted here.
(Click to continue)
(Highlight 'The Boot' in the hotbar)
But wait...this item is a Special Item. It doesn't Attack or Block. Take a look.
(When the user hovers)
This item allows you to instantly Defeat an Enemy if you have more HP than them!
(Click to continue)
That's a good item...
(Click to continue)
({nib} moves close to the viewer)
...but are you sure you want to use it?
(Click to continue)
({nib} returns)
So far you've lost zero HP in this dungeon, but remember â€” each time you clear a Dungeon, you heal back to full.
(Click to continue)
AND you get to keep all of the Loot that you didn't use in this dungeon. Pretty sweet, huh?
(Click to continue)
So I'll give you a choice. You can use The Boot and get the sweet satisfaction of stomping this Goblin into the dirt...
(Click to continue)
...Orrrr you can let him slice you up, and keep it. The choice is yours.
(The player will click on either The Boot or 'Take 3'. Either will resolve the combat)

---(If the player chose 'The Boot', after combat resolves)---
Honestly, I respect it. Those Goblins are super annoying, so here's a tip:
(Click to continue)
If you see one in your upcoming Dungeon, you should always hold onto a Block or Defeat item to avoid that damage.
(Click to continue)
You won't always have a Boot, after all.
(Click to continue â€” joins back with standard dialogue)
---(If the player chose to 'Take 3')---
Ouch â€” hurts, doesn't it?
(Click to continue)
Well the next time that Boot saves you from death in a future Dungeon, you'll be glad you let that little rascal nick you for 3.
(Click to continue)
I'm sure you can tell, but I'll give you a tip straight from the source:
(Click to continue)
Spend your HP like it was made of gold. Sometimes it will be correct to drop to 1 HP â€” you'll find Items that reward you for losing HP â€” we call that Bleeding.
(Click to continue â€” joins back with standard dialogue)
---JOINS TOGETHER
Alright, so you survived all 3 Monsters and cleared the Dungeon! Challenge Mode is the real haul — here's what happens when you go deeper.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights dungeon wheel)
Six monsters walk in. No empty corridors. A face-down deck sits off to the side — six more waiting to replace whoever you drop.
(Click to continue)
(Highlights 2 random slices)
Then, 2 of those starting Monsters will be upgraded to more dangerous foes
(Click to continue)
(Highlights hotbar)
Then you pick loot: two items at a time, matching the monsters already sitting on the wheel. You keep what you already hold, up to ten cards.
(Click to continue)
({nib} moves to center screen)
After that you pick who you fight. Click Begin when your loot is ready.
(Highlights Begin)
(Click 'next' to continue)
Then click a monster on the wheel — that click is the spin. Knock one down and you pick loot equal to their tier, then a new monster climbs out of the deck into that seat. When the deck's empty, the wheel starts closing for real.
(Highlights dungeon wheel)
(Click to continue)
Some items are very strong against certain monsters, and it's up to you to manage your resources and make it out with the best haul.
(Click to continue)
With that, I'm off to finish my nap again. Good luck with your dungeon delve, you greedy grubber!
(Click to continue)
(Animates {nib} 'walking off' to the right)
(vignette background, only buttons below are 'Main Menu' and 'Play', which goes to Challenge Mode)

rows.text: Your grandfather, the legendary {lucky_snatchwick}, has died inside {mountain}.

rows.where: Intro panel 3, Nib speaking
rows.text: He left you everything. Unfortunately, everything is still in the mountain.

rows.where: Intro panel 4 caption
rows.text: Up {hill}, in {the_grumble|poss} shadow, {nib} walks you home.

rows.where: Intro panel 5, Nib speaking
rows.text: Here we are, {hero}. Wipe your feet. He never did.

Will close-up headline
rows.text: The Last Will & Considerable Testament of {bartleby} {snatchwick}, Esq.

rows.where: Will close-up, paragraph 1
rows.text: I, {grandpa_full}, being of sound mind and even sounder luck, do hereby leave EVERYTHING to my grandchild, whom I met only once. You bit me. Good instincts.

rows.where: Will close-up, paragraph 2
rows.text: Everything is presently inside {mountain}, in the pockets of assorted monsters who picked it up after I fell over. Each piece is engraved with my name. They know it is not theirs.

rows.where: Will close-up, paragraph 3
rows.text: Bring my things home and set them in the {cabinet}. Only what you are holding when you get out counts. What the mountain keeps, it keeps.

rows.where: Will close-up, paragraph 4
rows.text: When the Cabinet is full, this cabin and the deed to {hill} are yours. {nib} will stamp it. {nib} loves stamping.

rows.where: Will close-up, paragraph 5
rows.text: {nib} is to be paid in biscuits. Do not open the left-hand drawer of my desk.

First visit, line 1
rows.text: Welcome home, {hero}. Well. His home. Yours on paper, once the cabinet's full.

rows.where: First visit, line 2
rows.text: Everything with his name on it went into the mountain with him. The monsters have been wearing it ever since.

rows.where: First visit, line 3
rows.text: Bring it back, put it on his shelves, and the deed's yours. I'll stamp it. I love stamping.

rows.where: Run door clicked before the tutorial is done
rows.text: Whoa, whoa. Straight into {the_grumble}? Without a word from the professional?

rows.where: Run door interrupt, offer
rows.text: First delve's on me. I'll walk you through it. What do you say?

rows.where: Interrupt choice: start the tutorial
Interrupt choice: decline
After declining
rows.text: Just like him. Off you go. Try to come back with more than you left with.

rows.where: After the tutorial finishes, back in the cabin
rows.text: There. Practically a professional. Now go and fetch his things.

rows.where: Click Nib (rotating line 1)
rows.text: He used to sit in that chair and flip a coin for hours. Never lost a toss. Never explained it.

rows.where: Click Nib (rotating line 2)
rows.text: The map's wrong, by the way. He drew it from memory. His memory was mostly confidence.

rows.where: Click Nib (rotating line 3)
rows.text: If the radio stops, tap the glass. Gently. {gloria} bites.

rows.where: Click Nib (rotating line 4)
rows.text: Every piece is engraved: 'Property of B. {snatchwick}. If found, how dare you.'

rows.where: Click Nib (rotating line 5)
rows.text: He tied rope ladders in every belly of the mountain. 'For emergencies.' He used them for lunch.

rows.where: Click Nib (rotating line 6)
rows.text: I'm not sentimental. I'm an executor. Executors don't cry. They file.

rows.where: Click the small portrait
rows.text: That's him, the year he lost a duel to a hatstand. He'd want me to say 'won'.

rows.where: Click the fire
rows.text: Keep it lit. He said the cabin gets lonely.

rows.where: Click the hero in the chair
rows.text: His chair. Rocks on its own sometimes. Draughts. Definitely draughts.

rows.where: Homecoming that crosses 25% of the cabinet
rows.text: A quarter of his shelves! He'd have thrown a party. Then knocked something over at it.

rows.where: Homecoming that crosses 50% of the cabinet
rows.text: Halfway, {hero}. The cabin's starting to smell like him again. That's a compliment. Mostly.

rows.where: Homecoming that crosses 75% of the cabinet
rows.text: Three quarters. I've started drafting the deed. In pencil. I'm not made of ink.

rows.where: Loss homecoming (random 1)
rows.text: Empty? Well. You came back. That's the part he never managed.

rows.where: Loss homecoming (random 2)
rows.text: The mountain keeps what it catches. You'll catch it back.

rows.where: Loss homecoming (random 3)
rows.text: Sit. Warm up. The Grumble isn't going anywhere. It's a mountain.

rows.where: Win homecoming (random 1)
rows.text: Look at that! Home where it belongs!

rows.where: Win homecoming (random 2)
Win homecoming (random 3)
rows.text: He'd be insufferable about this. In a good way.

rows.where: First NEW item flies to the hall
rows.text: That one's new! Off to the hall with it.

rows.where: Win homecoming with no new items
rows.text: Nothing new, but a good haul's a good haul. His things like being held.

rows.where: Key ring cutscene, Nib line 2

rows.where: Key ring cutscene, as each door unlocks
rows.text: The Workshop. Don't touch anything that ticks.

rows.where: Key ring cutscene, as each door unlocks
rows.text: The Loft. His bed, his telescope, his letters. Go gently.

rows.where: Key ring cutscene, last line
rows.text: There. It's your cabin now. Well. Nearly.
